label: real site
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 12 Market Street, city Springfield, ZIP 62701, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone 555 010 0199. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Clicking a product link looked like nothing happened; the page title and content stayed the same until I re-read the page.
Add to cart gave no clear confirmation; the button became Loading... and the cart count only updated later, with a mini-cart appearing without any announcement.
Cart and checkout pages loaded as empty skeleton tables (cells with no text) and needed several re-reads. Quantity buttons and combobox have no names.

Shipping form text boxes have no accessible names; labels (First name, Last name, Address, Postal code, City, Phone) are separate text, so I could only fill them by position. Country select and State field are also unnamed, and the email field is named by an error message (Enter a valid email address.) instead of Email.

Continue buttons stay disabled or show Loading... without announcement; the Continue to payment button needed an explicit click on the already-checked shipping radio, and Continue to review needed the payment radio to be re-selected.
Payment step has only a Manual Payment radio and a vague Another step will appear note; Edit buttons for each step share the same name so they are indistinguishable.

findings.problem: Clicking a product link looked like nothing happened; the page title and content stayed the same until I re-read the page.
Add to cart gave no clear confirmation; the button became Loading... and the cart count only updated later, with a mini-cart appearing without any announcement.
Cart and checkout pages loaded as empty skeleton tables (cells with no text) and needed several re-reads. Quantity buttons and combobox have no names.

Shipping form text boxes have no accessible names; labels (First name, Last name, Address, Postal code, City, Phone) are separate text, so I could only fill them by position. Country select and State field are also unnamed, and the email field is named by an error message (Enter a valid email address.) instead of Email.

Continue buttons stay disabled or show Loading... without announcement; the Continue to payment button needed an explicit click on the already-checked shipping radio, and Continue to review needed the payment radio to be re-selected.
Payment step has only a Manual Payment radio and a vague Another step will appear note; Edit buttons for each step share the same name so they are indistinguishable.
